input.config_yaml:
# ORPO = stage dpo + pref_loss orpo (there is no separate ORPO stage in LlamaFactory).
# Mirrors examples/train_lora/qwen3_lora_dpo.yaml on v0.9.5, with 4-bit QLoRA to fit 24 GB.
model_name_or_path: Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507
quantization_bit: 4
quantization_method: bnb
stage: dpo
finetuning_type: lora
lora_rank: 8
lora_target: all
pref_beta: 0.1
pref_loss: orpo  # sigmoid (DPO) | orpo | simpo
dataset: tiny_dpo
template: qwen3_nothink
cutoff_len: 1024
per_device_train_batch_size: 1
gradient_accumulation_steps: 8
learning_rate: 5.0e-6
num_train_epochs: 3.0
lr_scheduler_type: cosine
warmup_ratio: 0.1
bf16: true
